# Chapter 13: The Unwritten Future

There is nothing that terrifies a parent more than a sick child.

Bob learned this firsthand when his daughter was getting a doctor checkup for school sports and the doctor took him aside and said her blood counts were dangerously low and she needed to get to a hospital as soon as possible. They rushed her to the emergency room. The fluorescent lights buzzed overhead, casting a harsh white glow that made everything look clinical and cold. The doctors ran tests
